method.loss: seeded pseudo-random application-level drop in both directions
method.workload: fixed precomputed event schedule; counts, values, offsets, and SHA-256 workload fingerprint must match across policies

seed_derivation.loss_rate_index: zero-based position in the supplied loss_rates list
seed_derivation.policy_pairing: all policies at the same loss-rate index and repeat reuse the same case, simulation, and server seeds

latency_semantics.server_accept: original packet timestamp to first server acceptance, conditional on delivery, same-host wall clocks
latency_semantics.ack: client protocol-call time to accepted ACK/response; n/a for raw
latency_semantics.schedule_lateness: wall-clock backlog relative to the fixed logical schedule; packet timestamps begin when the protocol call is made

method.byte_semantics: attempted and passed-to-OS DART application bytes in both directions; includes registration/control setup and excludes UDP/IP/link headers
method.loss_pairing_caveat: policies use the same loss probability and seed, but retries/ACKs consume different PRNG draws, so individual drop events are not paired
